fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.text: The Freedom Front's release dated 28/9/2003 opens "Dr Pieter Mulder, VF leier," naming him as the Freedom Front's leader beside the leaders of the Konserwatiewe Party and the Afrikaner Eenheidsbeweging.

locator.section: Title line, date and first paragraph

rows.text: The release says the three leaders "het Saterdag (27/9/2003) in Pretoria aangekondig" that the three parties would take part in the 2004 election as one unit, and that "Die name KP, AEB en VF sal verdwyn en met VF+ vervang word" (the names KP, AEB and VF will disappear and be replaced by VF+).
The same release says the three parties would take part in the election "met die naam Vryheidsfront Plus (VF+)" (under the name Freedom Front Plus).

rows.role_title: Leader of the Freedom Front Plus (Vryheidsfront Plus)
rows.text: The release says the Konserwatiewe Party and AEB leaders "het hulle lojaliteit teenoor dr Mulder as leier van die Vryheidsfront Plus betuig" (pledged their loyalty to Dr Mulder as leader of the Freedom Front Plus).

bounded_scope: Freedom Front and Freedom Front Plus leader observations for CLAUDE-C01-30 only (role za_ff_leader on the VRYHEIDSFRONT PLUS observation). Founding, merger, renaming and another party's joining are organization claims (role_id null) and set no lifecycle or identity; elections, selection, re-election, retirement, death, the parliamentary leader office and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations are decided in the packet, not by any row.
